title: Camera coasting and edge scrolling move twice as fast on high-refresh displays
reason: Reports frame-count-based camera coast and edge-scroll motion whose speed scales with refresh rate. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve integrates hand inertia and edge scrolling using elapsed-frame time through navigationFrameDeltaMs and the navigation physics helpers, avoiding the reported fixed-per-tick speed scaling.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve integrates hand inertia and edge scrolling using elapsed-frame time through navigationFrameDeltaMs and the navigation physics helpers, avoiding the reported fixed-per-tick speed scaling.

title: Wheel events over the minimap are applied twice
reason: Reports a minimap wheel dispatch combined with a container's pass-through redispatch, applying one gesture twice. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve's MinimapPanel has pointer-based navigation and no wheel forwarding or canvas redispatch handler, so the duplicate wheel path described upstream is absent.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's MinimapPanel has pointer-based navigation and no wheel forwarding or canvas redispatch handler, so the duplicate wheel path described upstream is absent.

title: Held keys are not cleared when the window loses focus
reason: Reports missed keyup events after application/window focus loss leaving modifiers and temporary navigation active. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve cancels canvas interactions on window blur and document visibility loss; ToolManager resets modifiers and the generic nudge controller finishes on focus loss. The upstream stale-key contract already has local safeguards.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve cancels canvas interactions on window blur and document visibility loss; ToolManager resets modifiers and the generic nudge controller finishes on focus loss. The upstream stale-key contract already has local safeguards.

title: Toolbar does not hide while editing text on mobile
reason: Reports an upstream mobile editing flag that is written but never consumed by its stylesheet. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve uses its own responsive workspace and text-edit overlays rather than the described layout data attribute and toolbar CSS contract; no same stale-flag defect is established by this report.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve uses its own responsive workspace and text-edit overlays rather than the described layout data attribute and toolbar CSS contract; no same stale-flag defect is established by this report.

title: Screen-reader announcements say tool.group and 0 of N
reason: Reports untranslated group type keys and top-level-only position indexing in tldraw's selection announcements. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve's CanvasAnnouncer builds human-readable node-kind and name messages and does not report ordinal positions, so it avoids the raw key/0-of-N failures. Nested reading-order and group naming remain a broader accessibility opportunity, not a demonstrated regression from this issue.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's CanvasAnnouncer builds human-readable node-kind and name messages and does not report ordinal positions, so it avoids the raw key/0-of-N failures. title: Actions menu opens empty in readonly mode with the hand and zoom tools
reason: Reports a toolbar/actions-menu inconsistency in hosted readonly rooms. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve has no hosted readonly collaboration mode, so the room-permission branch and empty collaborative actions grid do not map to a current product path.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no hosted readonly collaboration mode, so the room-permission branch and empty collaborative actions grid do not map to a current product path.

title: Escape ends a Space pan while Space is still held
reason: Reports Escape cancelling a held Space-pan gesture even though the temporary hand key remains down. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve treats Escape as cancellation of the active canvas gesture, while its spring-loaded Hand tool remains armed until Space keyup. This is an interaction-contract choice rather than an evident stale state; do not make Escape preserve a drag without revising the documented cancellation semantics.

title: Opening a menu or pressing undo mid-press creates a shape in some tools but not others
reason: Reports inconsistent tldraw tool outcomes when a press-only gesture receives a completion event before pointerup. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve separates pointer cancellation from normal pointerup and individual creation tools own their commit paths. The upstream state-machine divergence does not itself establish that Varve commits an unwanted default shape when a menu or undo interrupts a press; targeted reproduction would be needed before changing gesture completion semantics.

title: Eraser: pressing a frame's outline and dragging may or may not erase the frame
reason: Reports tldraw vector eraser frame-border hit behavior depending on whether the drag begins inside or outside the frame. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve's eraser is a raster paint/mask tool and has no corresponding vector-frame eraser selection behavior, so the reported press-origin ambiguity is outside its current implementation.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's eraser is a raster paint/mask tool and has no corresponding vector-frame eraser selection behavior, so the reported press-origin ambiguity is outside its current implementation.

title: Laser trail stays visible after changing page
reason: Reports transient laser trails surviving a page switch because the upstream scribble manager does not associate trails with pages. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve does not currently ship a laser presentation tool or page-agnostic transient laser trail manager, so there is no matching state lifecycle to repair.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not currently ship a laser presentation tool or page-agnostic transient laser trail manager, so there is no matching state lifecycle to repair.
